column1: Category|ID|Title|Rule|Source

Session|SES-01|Listen server|Host plays and simulates; friends join by address and UDP 7777. LAN discovery exists. Internet requires reachable routing/firewall; no relay or NAT traversal is implemented.|ReserveSession.cs,SessionAddress.cs,LanDiscovery.cs

Session|SES-02|Capacity and teams|Twenty participants including bots maximum; solo/duo/squad teams contain one/two/four. Team allocation and pending approvals reserve capacity; practice bots can yield a full slot.|WildfrontMatch.cs,RoundArena.cs,ReserveSession.cs
Session|SES-03|Ready flow|Host selects rules. Unready humans block launch and withdrawing readiness cancels countdown. Battle royale and free-roam sandbox are separate modes.|ReserveLobby.cs

Session|SES-04|Practice and late join|Practice fills to eight with bots. Bots move, scavenge, fight, swim and can be downed. Joining a draft/active round spectates until the next round.|WildfrontMatch.cs,HunterBot.cs

Session|SES-05|Exit and rehost|Leave cleans actors, microphone, narration and registries while retaining reusable static terrain/atlas. Rehost works repeatedly; settings never pause shared physics.|ReserveSession.cs
Draft|DRA-01|Budget|Each player has ten points; bid plus one of eight starting-kit costs cannot exceed ten. Exact kits and defaults are in Legacy/balance.json.|SpawnDraft.cs,ExpeditionLayout.cs

Draft|DRA-02|Shared sequential choices|Each player bids and lands separately, including teammates. Bids, kit/intents and map previews replicate so all participants see collective decisions.|SpawnDraft.cs

Draft|DRA-03|Priority and deadlines|High bids select first; ties rotate deterministically by round. Bid turns last 25 seconds, landing turns eighteen; bots/timeouts/disconnections have fallback decisions.|SpawnDraft.cs

Draft|DRA-04|Free point selection|Choose a safe valid point inside the arena or an unclaimed named region. Resolve ground/obstructions/water; opposing selected landings reserve a sixty-metre exclusion.|SpawnDraft.cs,FreeSpawn.cs
Draft|DRA-05|Kit tradeoff|Unspent points after bid/kit yield one spare magazine per two points. Kits vary primary/sidearm, rarity, ammo, medicine, repair supplies, fuel and armor.|RangerEquipment.cs

Draft|DRA-06|Deployment reset|Only draft participants deploy; others spectate. Restore player kits/orders, construction, wildlife, loot, transport and supply schedule as a coordinated round transition.|WildfrontMatch.cs
World|WRL-01|Arena tiers|1–5 participants: 2048 m; 6–12: 4096 m; 13–20: 6144 m. Five is small. Bots count. Arena freezes per round; free roam stays full size.|RoundArena.cs

World|WRL-02|Biomes|Meadow, desert, frozen expanse, mountains, jungle and wetlands, plus autumn floodplain. Terrain, texture, foliage, animals, precipitation and sound must reflect habitat.|ReserveBiomes.cs,ReserveUnderstory.cs

World|WRL-03|Named places|Sixty alliterative two-word sites: fourteen major, forty-six minor; 444 buildings, 89 roads and 44 mobility stops. Exact names/coordinates/descriptions are exported.|ExpeditionLayout.cs,VillageFootprints.cs

World|WRL-04|Water|Five lakes and river surfaces support depth, shorelines, swimming, bridges, boating and loot consistently. Painted water alone is not a gameplay water implementation.|ReserveWater.cs,RangerWater.cs

World|WRL-05|Caves and mountains|Six terrain-integrated branching caves include chambers, side routes, a loop, caches and blue/violet/teal crystals. Underground movement and drops remain underground; varied mountains/mesas supply verticality.|CaveLayout.cs

World|WRL-06|Activities|Scavenging, hunting, orders, relays, caches, mobility stops, fixed pads, supplies and anomalies fill routes. New villages need intentional cover/routes/activities, not repeated empty huts.|ExpeditionLoot.cs,FieldAnomaly.cs

Storm|STM-01|Phases|Warmup, sequential bids, sequential landing, active battle and results are distinct server phases. Rings wait, then close; the next target is visible ahead of time.|WildfrontMatch.cs,SpawnDraft.cs

Storm|STM-02|Schedule|Full-size targets: 3040/2200/1520/938/500/200/0 m. Waits: 90/60/55/45/40/30/20 s; closes: 100/140/125/110/85/60/45 s. Scale radii by arena/6144. Initial radius equals arena size × 0.704.|WildfrontMatch.cs

Storm|STM-03|Moving circles|First target is centered at origin. Later targets use bounded randomized drift. Center/radius interpolate throughout closing; preserve explicit formulas until a reviewed rebalance.|WildfrontMatch.cs

Storm|STM-04|Exposure|Outside circle or arena costs 2+2×stage-index health each second. Armor never absorbs storm. Wall, tint, warning/damage feedback, map, countdown and narration communicate danger.|WildfrontMatch.cs,StormView.cs

Storm|STM-05|Victory|In multi-team battles the last alive team wins; zero teams gives no winner. Downed counts alive until eliminated. Results/restart restore participants for the next draft.|WildfrontMatch.cs

Storm|STM-06|Animal pressure|Closing enrages/tints living land wildlife, including normally peaceful prey. Outside closing, wildlife near the storm edge tries to reach safety.|Wildlife.cs,SharkLife.cs

Movement|MOV-01|Speeds and view|Walk 4.8 m/s, sprint 9.4, crouch 2.5 before hunger penalties. Select first/third person; aiming changes camera/FOV; scoped weapons can enter scoped view.|RangerMovement.cs,RangerCamera.cs

Movement|MOV-02|Stamina and hunger|Sprint uses stamina with regeneration/reduced fatigue. Hunger below twenty locks sprint; below ten multiplies ordinary movement by 0.7. Avoid an unexplained low global momentum cap.|Ranger.cs,RangerMovement.cs

Movement|MOV-03|Slide|Crouch while grounded and moving ≥6.5 m/s. Standing crouch is not sliding. Momentum entry up to 26 m/s, slope influence, 1.35 s duration, 1.7 s cooldown; jump can exit.|RangerMovement.cs

Movement|MOV-04|Bunny hop|150 ms jump buffer, 100 ms edge grace, held jump chaining. Repeated hops add 1.7 m/s up to 24 with air steering. Reset on teleport, respawn, water, vehicles and pads.|RangerMovement.cs,LaunchPad.cs

Movement|MOV-05|Replicated stance|Other players see crouch, slide, glider and facing. Stance, animation and hit regions agree; changing only the local camera is insufficient.|RangerMovement.cs,PlayerHitboxes.cs,AvatarStyle.cs

Movement|MOV-06|Menus|Inventory/map/settings consume appropriate input without freezing gravity, vehicles, storm or others. Restore camera/cursor/input on close, death and rehost.|Ranger.cs,RangerCamera.cs

Movement|MOV-07|Swim|Depth selects swimming and movement follows water surface. Boarding boats protects swimmers from sharks; exiting can expose them. Water behavior is distinct from ordinary ground motion.|RangerWater.cs,SharkLife.cs

Weapons|WPN-01|Taxonomy|Eight explicit classes: sniper, assault rifle, shotgun, pistol, SMG, marksman rifle, support gun, launcher. Category/mode/cadence/damage/spread/pellets/reload/range/zoom are data, not inferred from a model.|WeaponData.cs

Weapons|WPN-02|Definitions|Ridgeline, Trail Scout, Brushmaster, Service Nine, Kestrel, Longwatch, Sawmill and Stormbreak RPG retain exported parameter tables. Each eventually needs appropriate model, handling, sound and animation.|WeaponData.cs

Weapons|WPN-03|Rarity|Common/uncommon/rare/epic/legendary: gray/green/blue/purple/amber. Damage multiplier 1+0.065×rarity-index. Rarity cues must not erase realistic weapon materials.|WeaponData.cs,LootModels.cs

Weapons|WPN-04|Aim and falloff|Class-specific range falloff; shotgun/SMG/pistol lose more than sniper/marksman. Aim/crouch affect spread; class-specific bloom/recoil apply. Aiming and shooting work simultaneously.|WeaponData.cs,RangerGunHandling.cs

Weapons|WPN-05|Ammo|Pools: .308, .223, 12-gauge, 9 mm and rockets. Magazines persist per gun through slot changes/drop. Reload consumes compatible reserves only and cannot create ammo.|RangerEquipment.cs,RangerSlots.cs

Weapons|WPN-06|Server validation|Validate alive/action, equipment/reload/ammo, finite origin/direction, reach, cadence, timestamps and monotonic sequences. Reject replays and client-declared damage.|RangerCombat.cs

Weapons|WPN-07|Hit regions|Stance-aware anatomical player regions and model-fitted oriented animal bounds register front/side/rear. Player headshots multiply by 1.4. Crosshair-only client damage is invalid.|PlayerHitboxes.cs,WildlifeHitboxes.cs

Weapons|WPN-08|Latency fairness|Legacy uses 500 ms bounded history, presentation-delay compensation, current cover and aggregate pellet damage. Unreal needs remote-shot/latency fairness tests; replicated movement alone is not parity.|ShotHistory.cs,RangerCombat.cs

Weapons|WPN-09|RPG|Server traveling rocket, blast falloff, cover protection and structure damage. Dedicated rocket ammo and one-round reload. Launcher accepts only the speed-loader handling mod.|RocketProjectile.cs,WeaponMods.cs

Weapons|WPN-10|Feedback|Immediate local shot prediction is separate from server damage confirmation. Distinct hits/headshots/armor/break/kills, recoil, muzzle/impact/tracer, near/far positional audio and incoming feedback.|CombatFeedback.cs,CombatEffects.cs,RangerDamageSignals.cs

Attachments|MOD-01|Slots and compatibility|Three slots: optic/barrel/handling; nine definitions exported. One per slot/weapon; marksman optic fits selected rifles/support gun; RPG accepts only speed loader.|WeaponMods.cs

Attachments|MOD-02|Effects|Optics 1.5/3/6×; reinforced barrel +12% damage; precision barrel -25% spread; brake -30% recoil; loader -20% reload time; grip -20% spread/-15% recoil; stock -25% recoil.|WeaponMods.cs

Attachments|MOD-03|Transactions|Bag stacks cap five. Fit consumes one and returns replaced mod if space; detach checks space. Show explicit effect/compatibility. Guns carry fitted mods when dropped/shared.|WeaponMods.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Inventory|INV-01|Slots|Three gun slots plus pickaxe/food/heal hotbar. Slot/icon inventory reorders without magazine loss. Hold Alt opens, release closes; saved custom bindings survive.|RangerSlots.cs,FieldcraftUI.cs

Inventory|INV-02|Capacity|Ammo 400 per ordinary pool, rockets twelve; medkits/fuel five; food eight; plates six; survey charges two; pads three; repair supplies fifty; wood/stone/metal 999 each.|RangerEquipment.cs,RangerSurvival.cs

Inventory|INV-03|Sharing|Drop guns, ammo, food, medicine, armor/plates, mods, repair/fuel, materials, pads and surveys. Partial pickups leave excess; validate range, quantity, ownership, capacity and state.|RangerSurvival.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Inventory|INV-04|Identity and placement|Dropped guns preserve rarity/magazine/mods, vests preserve durability/tier. Drops stay on reachable cave/water surfaces rather than teleporting up through terrain.|RangerSurvival.cs,CaveLayout.cs

Inventory|INV-05|Ground models|Recognizable equipment with natural surface finish and restrained rarity markers replaces generic blocks. Detailed model culling cannot remove authoritative pickup state.|LootModels.cs,ExpeditionVisuals.cs

Survival|SUR-01|Initial state|Health 100; normal equipment initialization gives hunger 85 and one food. Practice/free-roam equipment differs from draft kits intentionally.|Ranger.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Survival|SUR-02|Hunger|Each second lose 0.15 hunger moving >5 m/s, 0.045 mounted, otherwise 0.065. UI communicates thresholds. At zero, three health damage every three seconds; sprint locks under twenty.|RangerSurvival.cs

Survival|SUR-03|Food and healing|Food: +35 hunger/+5 health; medkit +45 health; rich meat +20 health/+15 hunger, capped at 100. Reject unusable/full restoration where appropriate to avoid wasting resources.|RangerSurvival.cs,RangerEquipment.cs
Armor|ARM-01|Tiers|Light/field/heavy durability 50/75/100; absorption 25/35/50%, bounded by remaining armor. This is source-specific protection, not a universal second health bar.|RangerArmor.cs

Armor|ARM-02|Sources|Gunshots and animal attacks use armor; storm, hunger and anomaly exposure bypass it. Unreal should use explicit damage types, replacing negative attacker-number conventions.|RangerArmor.cs,FieldAnomaly.cs

Armor|ARM-03|Equip and plate|Equipping has a separate blue pulse, never a red damage flash. One plate restores thirty durability to an equipped nonfull vest; replacement leaves the old vest as loot.|RangerArmor.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Death|DED-01|Knock|Active duo/squad lethal damage can down if an ally fights and fewer than two previous knocks. Start downed at 35 health, thirty-second bleed; cannot fight/drive; further damage can eliminate.|Ranger.cs,RangerRescue.cs
Death|DED-02|Revive|Hold interact three seconds within 3.2 m; input pulses expire at 0.45 s. Damage/state/range interrupts. Revive restores 35 health and at least 25 hunger.|RangerRescue.cs

Death|DED-03|Elimination|Cancel actions/vehicle, drop inventory, credit opposing killer and announce globally. Free roam respawns after six seconds; battle royale waits for next round.|RangerRescue.cs,Ranger.cs

Death|DED-04|Spectating|Solo: cycle all survivors. Duo/squad: surviving teammates only until the whole team dies, then everybody. Camera, interest, inputs and map privacy follow the observer.|RangerSpectator.cs

Wildlife|ANI-01|Species|Six habitat tables distribute sixteen prefab species including sharks. Exact prefab health/kind are exported. Habitat, water, clearing, slope, arena and varied session timing constrain spawning.|WildlifeDirector.cs,SharkLife.cs

Wildlife|ANI-02|Population|Forty land animals per available habitat, 320 live ceiling. Every four–seven seconds, relevant replenishment targets fourteen within 260 m of a human fighter, with ninety-metre player buffers.|WildlifeDirector.cs

Wildlife|ANI-03|Normal behavior|Boars/wolves/bears/sharks classify hostile; deer/hare/fox and other prey flee normally. Bear classification exists without an instantiated bear asset. Do not invent species as completed content.|Wildlife.cs

Wildlife|ANI-04|Senses|Range/facing/LOS/crouch/speed/rage affect detection. Predators investigate gunshots, prey flees, herd members react to nearby damage. Animation/audio should telegraph state before a cheap attack.|Wildlife.cs,WildlifeSound.cs

Wildlife|ANI-05|Mutations|Closing tints/enrages land animals. Once per stage, eligible nearby animals roll 12%, at most four live bosses. Boss scale 1.7, max HP 3×, attack 1.7×, speed 1.15×; sharks excluded.|StormMutation.cs,Wildlife.cs

Wildlife|ANI-06|Hunting|Valid shots/pickaxe kill animals; rewards and corpse harvest are one-time. Death stops movement; corpses clean after eighty seconds. Small HP bars appear on relevant focus/damage.|Wildlife.cs,RangerConstruction.cs

Wildlife|ANI-07|Explicit reward override|User superseded organic-only drops. Extra equipment chance: normal 35%, enraged 80%, boss two guaranteed rolls. No pelts, bones, storm trophies or crafting economy.|AnimalLoot.cs

Wildlife|ANI-08|Reward distribution|Equipment roll: weapon 18%, ammo 29%, mod 20%, vest 13%, plates 10%, medkit 5%, pad 5%. Normal/enraged/boss rarities differ; bosses may yield legendary. Base food/meat is separate.|AnimalLoot.cs,WildfrontMatch.cs
Wildlife|ANI-09|Sharks|Seek fighting swimmers within 65 m, attack within 3 m for eighteen every 1.5 s; remain in sufficient water. Occupied boats protect players; no shark bosses.|SharkLife.cs

Construction|BLD-01|Harvest|Visible pickaxe and key; start 80 wood/40 stone/20 metal, discover/share more. Resource HP/depletion/disappearance synchronize; each resource caps 999.|RangerConstruction.cs,HarvestResources.cs

Construction|BLD-02|Pickaxe damage|45 resource damage yields normally lost-health/3 materials (minimum one); build sixty, animal thirty, player twenty. Local swing 0.48 s, server cadence 0.45 s.|RangerConstruction.cs

Construction|BLD-03|Four forms|Wall/floor/stairs/pyramid, ten material each; 4 m horizontal cells/3 m storeys. Four build bindings above weapons. Hold fire turbo places at 0.09 s intervals.|BuildGrid.cs,RangerConstruction.cs

Construction|BLD-04|Orientation and snap|Start relative to camera/player facing; connected grid inherits origin/yaw. Automatic quarter turns with six-degree dead band after diagonals; R adds rotation. Aim-projected floors extend; jumps retain grid/storey.|BuildGrid.cs,RangerConstruction.cs

Construction|BLD-05|Placement|Alive/actionable/on foot, finite valid coordinates/type/material/turn, twelve-metre reach, grid alignment, materials, bounds/support, no duplicates/obstructions/player trapping.|ConstructionWorld.cs

Construction|BLD-06|Health and limits|Eighty pieces/player, 512 globally. Wood/stone/metal maxima 300/450/600 HP; new pieces start eighty and grow for six seconds. Compact context HP indicators.|ConstructionWorld.cs,BuildPiece.cs

Construction|BLD-07|Edit forms|Nearby allied structures only. Walls use connected 3×3 masks, windows/doors/low/diagonal patterns; floors/ramps quadrants and pyramids alternate forms. Reset restores full geometry.|BuildPiece.cs,ConstructionWorld.cs

Construction|BLD-08|Editing controls|H enters/confirms, mouse paints, RMB resets, R rotates eligible ramps/pyramids, Escape cancels. No edit closing through players. Door use/open state replicates separately.|RangerConstruction.cs,FieldcraftUI.cs

Construction|BLD-09|Repair and support|Two matching material repairs fifty HP. Destroy support and unsupported connected pieces collapse. Edits, doors, HP and sparse harvest state reconcile for late joiners.|ConstructionWorld.cs,BuildPiece.cs

Construction|BLD-10|Parity limit|Four main forms/current masks exist; complete Fortnite edit patterns/prediction/art/animations were not established. Unreal must explicitly test camera-relative 90-degree building chains.|BuildGrid.cs,BuildPiece.cs
Launchpads|PAD-01|Placement|Fixed map pads plus lootable pads (carry three). F5 attaches to a complete nearby allied floor. Duplicate placement rejects without spending an item.|LaunchPad.cs
Launchpads|PAD-02|Launch|Server contact check and per-player 2.5 s cooldown. Forward 21/up 25 m/s; automatic glider on descent, steering eighteen, descent capped 4.8 m/s.|LaunchPad.cs
Launchpads|PAD-03|Support and privacy|Floor removal/edit removes mounted pad; pad 250 HP. Public fixed pins do not expose enemy built pads. Glider pose/state replicates.|LaunchPad.cs,TransportMap.cs

Vehicles|VEH-01|Fleet and seats|Wagon, buggy, pickup, van, motor launch, motorcycle; 112 starting full-world vehicles including ten boats. Two seats buggy/bike, four otherwise.|RoadVehicle.cs,ExpeditionLoot.cs

Vehicles|VEH-02|Speed|Base 29/43/35/25/29/48 m/s × (0.3+0.7×condition/100) × (1+0.12×tune). Reverse one-third; boost ×1.4 and costs charge/fuel. Exact acceleration/steering/fuel remain code-linked.|RoadVehicle.cs

Vehicles|VEH-03|Authority and input|Server simulation; current human driver alone commands gas/steering/brake/boost. Reject nonfinite/expired input; support free-look and responsive steering. Enemy teams cannot board occupied hostile vehicles.|RoadVehicle.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Vehicles|VEH-04|Services|Two repair supplies +30 condition; one fuel can +45 fuel; three repair supplies add tune up to level two. Dead engine needs repair, empty tank fuel; show concrete effects.|RangerEquipment.cs

Vehicles|VEH-05|Terrain handling|Drive continuous slopes at graded speed; reject cliffs/collisions, follow bridges/builds, interpolate host camera/body. Parked empty cars sleep. Do not copy legacy hard uphill stalls into Chaos.|RoadVehicle.cs

Vehicles|VEH-06|Water travel|Boats use any valid connected water at depth ≥0.35 m, not one named lake/river. Safe shore/swim exits, aboard fighting and shark protection are required.|RoadVehicle.cs,RangerWater.cs
Vehicles|VEH-07|Map|Type-specific live icons about once per second; condition/fuel. Hide enemy-occupied transport so icons do not expose ordinary opponent positions.|TransportMap.cs
Supplies|SUP-01|Schedule|First scheduled supply at 65 s, then 140 s spacing; at most six scheduled drops; no new schedule when next radius <200 m. Favor next safe zone.|SupplyDrop.cs
Supplies|SUP-02|Flight|Aircraft flyover, parachute, landing at 26 s; map/narrator/global cues. Interact within 4.5 m after landing; server opens and rewards once.|SupplyDrop.cs

Supplies|SUP-03|Specials|35% motorcycle, next 25% survey, otherwise ordinary supply. Bike obstruction fallback is survey. Base weapon/ammo/medical contents remain specified in source.|SurveyBeacon.cs,SupplyDrop.cs

Supplies|SUP-04|Survey exception|Carry two. Twelve seconds active, opponent snapshots every four seconds for activating team only; all players warned. Ordinary opponents otherwise never appear on the map.|SurveyBeacon.cs

Supplies|SUP-05|Caches and relays|Cache: mod, medicine, plates. Selected hamlet relay: contestable global supply flight, shared 180 s cooldown, not private silent loot.|ExpeditionLoot.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Supplies|SUP-06|Anomalies|Attempt six/ten/fourteen sites for small/medium/full arena. Blue motes, 7 m hazard: four health every two seconds during active match, bypass armor. Securing removes hazard and adds epic gun 80%/legendary 20% plus cache supplies.|FieldAnomaly.cs,RangerEquipment.cs

Objectives|OBJ-01|Field orders|Reach a nearby unvisited named region, hunt, survive a safe storm cycle, then new orders. Hunting and completion grant explicit supplies. State/rewards remain server-owned.|RangerSurvival.cs

Objectives|OBJ-02|Counters|Player eliminations, hunts/harvests, orders and team victory are distinct. Encourage exploration and tactical choices; no fake progression/currency UI.|Ranger.cs,RangerSurvival.cs

Presentation|UI-01|Front end|Main/host/join/discovery/mode/team/roster/readiness, address+port, character, settings and complete handbook. Only functioning controls; no fake stores/passes/premium currencies/ranks.|FrontDoorUI.cs,ReserveUI.cs

Presentation|UI-02|Combat HUD|Compass/minimap, survivors/teams/kills, ring/time, health/blue armor/hunger/stamina, ammo/class/reload, tool/weapons/build bindings, notices/captions/context prompts; keep world visible.|BattleHUD.cs

Presentation|UI-03|Team visibility|Minimal teammate HP/armor/downed/name information, head nametags and map pins. Nearby animal dots have another color. Ordinary enemies disappear from map after deployment.|BattleHUD.cs,FieldAtlasPanel.cs

Presentation|UI-04|Atlas|Detailed overhead terrain, zoom/pan, readable alliterative place labels with collision handling, roads/buildings/water/current-next circles and authorized team/vehicle/pad/supply/objective pins.|FieldAtlas.cs,FieldAtlasPanel.cs
Presentation|UI-05|Animal radar|Approximately seventy-five-metre nearby animal dots help prey tracking; distinct from team icons. Not unrestricted opponent tracking.|FieldHUD.cs,FieldAtlasPanel.cs

Presentation|UI-06|Damage information|Distinct confirmed outgoing/incoming/head/armor/break/kill feedback and storm tint. Enemy HP only briefly after damage and unobstructed; no permanent reveal or through-cover HP labels.|RangerDamageSignals.cs,FieldcraftUI.cs
Presentation|UI-07|Inventory|Slots/icons/rarity, quantities, armor and explicit mod effects; drop/reorder/fit/remove with background visible. No unexplained gun tuning.|FieldcraftUI.cs,RangerSlots.cs

Presentation|UI-08|Readability and bindings|Text fits supported windows, long copy scrolls, long names handled. Persist rebindings. Hold inventory/emote actions differ from toggles. Restore cursor and do not pause shared physics.|ReadableUI.cs,GameBindings.cs

Presentation|UI-09|Appearance|Body model, palette, headgear and first/third view exist, but current character/gear meshes are partly placeholders. Do not claim that equals a realistic-human Unreal asset pipeline.|AvatarStyle.cs,CharacterPreview.cs

Audio|AUD-01|Soundscape|Recorded class-specific gunshots with near/far/occlusion layers, restrained surface footsteps, positional animal calls/engines/water/weather. Remove fatiguing repetition/sharp synthetic beeps.|CombatSounds.cs,ReserveAudio.cs,WildlifeSound.cs,Soundscape.cs

Audio|AUD-02|Narrator|Global storm/supply/kill/mutation/relay/victory events, varied remarks, captions and priority queue. Existing offline WAV bank is replaceable content, not a paid runtime TTS dependency.|FieldNarrator.cs,WildfrontMatch.cs

Audio|AUD-03|Proximity speech|Opt-in mic; PTT and open mic. Anybody including opponents hears distance-faded voice to seventy-five metres. Warm capture prevents key stutter; buffered receive handles jitter.|ProximityVoice.cs,VoiceJitterBuffer.cs

Audio|AUD-04|Voice settings|Input/threshold/output/mutes/talk indicators; stop capture on disable/leave. No microphone automation. Synthetic packets prove routing, not physical-device or internet audio quality.|ProximityVoice.cs

Weather|WTH-01|Cycle|Full day 300 s of play. Host clear/overcast/storm selection; weather cycles every 180 s if enabled. Biome-specific rain/snow/dust; time continues in menus.|WeatherState.cs,ReserveWeather.cs

Weather|WTH-02|Atmosphere|Shared wetness/cloud/sky/fog/light/precipitation and delayed thunder. Battle storm exposure is separate from ordinary weather. Cinematic changes must preserve opponents and prey readability.|ReserveWeather.cs,StormView.cs
Emotes|EMO-01|Radial input|Hold C, mouse direction, release to choose; center cancels; LMB commits, RMB/Escape cancels. Selection click cannot shoot. Rebindable action.|EmoteWheel.cs

Emotes|EMO-02|Gestures|Wave/Cheer/Point/Salute/Clap/Shuffle, finite replicated original poses. Alive, grounded, stationary, on-foot only. Motion, combat, damage, water/vehicles and expiry interrupt.|RangerEmotes.cs

Engineering|NET-01|Authority redesign|Server controls damage, inventory, rewards, storm, draft, animals, cars and building. Replace legacy owner-driven movement with Unreal prediction/correction; it is not a secure anti-cheat model.|OwnerTransform.cs,RangerCombat.cs

Engineering|NET-02|Relevance and lifecycle|Interest follows players/spectators; handle hide/show/despawn/late join/rehost races. Visual culling never removes collision/state. Map transport is a separately filtered feed.|WorldInterest.cs,TransportMap.cs

Engineering|NET-03|Budgets|Bound far AI, parked cars, harvested changes, build counts and cosmetic pools; cache terrain/styles/icons. Rendered host with clients and frame tails proves FPS, not null-renderer simulation speed. No GPU-vendor logic.|RuntimePerformance.cs,PresentationBudget.cs

Engineering|NET-04|Scalability|Hardware-independent quality/view distance/frame targets, volume/captions/bindings. GPU was already active in Unity. Unreal Lumen/Nanite/TSR are tools, not automatic realism or FPS guarantees.|RuntimePerformance.cs

Engineering|NET-05|Content acceptance|Every asset needs license, scale, rig, collisions, LOD and cost. Preserve Unity GUID/evidence. Internet, physical mic, twenty independent users, long matches and production art need separate tests.|ReserveSession.cs

Outstanding requests|GAP-01|Aircraft|Supply planes are flyovers only. Pilotable planes were proposed, not implemented. Track a future decision rather than claiming migrated existing capability.|SupplyDrop.cs

Outstanding requests|GAP-02|Commercial parity|Complete Fortnite edits/build prediction, Apex-quality slide animation and CS2-style contrast were inspirations, not verified parity. Require explicit behavior/visual scenes and original licensed art.|BuildPiece.cs,RangerMovement.cs

Outstanding requests|GAP-03|Professional finish|Host performance regression, simple cars/animals/characters, imperfect pickup selection/cameras, limited bots, owner movement and absent relay are improvement requirements, not legacy rules to reproduce.|RoadVehicle.cs,Ranger.cs,OwnerTransform.cs
